answer: Because the comet ledger attributes every share, the copper audit shows the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. Only 66% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not forfeit. A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, which means it forfeits the pulse fee twice and still divides one payout. That is 18 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
